metric_definitions.event_recall: An alert on explicitly injected support, available within onset through onset+3 frames; long ID-swap tails also reported by slot recall. Symptom alert is not cause identification.
metric_definitions.false_alarm: Only synthetic healthy observed slots outside known support; real data has no natural-error false-positive labels.
metric_definitions.worsened: Synthetic output position has greater error than input by >1e-6 px.
metric_definitions.availability: Policy-accepted observed coverage: review excludes flagged slots; naive policies release all emitted positions, even flagged. This is not a shared unflagged rate or accuracy. Missing truth and spurious candidates are separate.
metric_definitions.metric_permission: Hypothetical capability gate comparison only: pixel-only naive methods have no calibration gate, modeled as permission=True; they do not actually emit metric estimates.
metric_definitions.delay: First alert availability minus injected onset in PTS seconds. Gap alerts require reappearance.
metric_definitions.actual_input_disturbance: Changes to untouched model-output coordinates; not a natural accuracy metric.
metric_definitions.source_fields: Original files remain byte-identical; analysis uses separate bbox-center views. All raw fields remain available.

same_team_occlusion.world_1: Two visually indistinguishable players pass through occlusion along +/-200*(t-.4)^3; IDs stay correct.
same_team_occlusion.world_2: Players turn back along +/-200*abs(t-.4)^3 under occlusion; IDs swap after t=.4.
same_team_occlusion.assumption: No usable jersey, face, appearance, ball-contact, or independent identity evidence. Both worlds have continuous velocity and acceleration; crossing idealizes an unobserved occlusion interval.
same_team_occlusion.conclusion: Position/box geometry alone cannot choose the correct identity assignment.

global_translation.world_1: Stationary players, camera image translation 80 px/s.
global_translation.world_2: Static camera, all players translate 80 px/s.
global_translation.conclusion: Subtracting median track displacement declares world 2 motion zero. Require background/court evidence to attribute camera motion.

metric_scale.conclusion: Image trajectories alone do not identify absolute metric scale or silently wrong calibration.

latency_notes.review_geometry: Causal incoming transition and same-frame ambiguity: zero additional frames.
latency_notes.review_gap: Offline retrospective gap annotation at reappearance, three-frame gap = 3 frame periods.
latency_notes.naive_repair: Centered smoothing requires one future frame; interpolation needs next retained endpoint, up to four frame periods. No live-system timing claim.
latency_notes.identity_resolution: Not achieved by any method; review alerts are not repaired identity.
